The way I was treated from initial call for an appointment to actually seeing a doctor was absolutely first class.

Some issues arose which were handled by one of the receptionists named Jo.

She was absolutely brilliant as she took ownership of my dilemma and saw that my illness really did need urgent attention.

She kept me updated and ensured that I didn't get any worse before I was actually seen to.

Jo appeared to go that extra mile just to try and help me get to see a doctor and this left me with a most positive experience which I felt needed recognition for such great patient service.

Well done Jo, and keep up the great work as  you're a credit to King Street
